# `set_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Change one or more device settings in a single object, non-transactionally.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xedf40 (auto_power_off @0xefcb8, guest_mode @0xf0f9c, usb_en_eth @0xf0eac, dark_mode @0xf0c58, guest-settings fallback @0xf1c90), guest_mode_set_master @0x6b5040 (64-bit build); firmware 9.75 key-table additions from the 9.75 reports (handler @0x10a230, 64-bit build) and resolver report E (stack branch @0x10c238 and @0x10c42c, exp_ms branch @0x10e308, enable_dark_library @0x10e788, can_encrypt @0x10d110, motion_monitor @0x10b128, parser @0xefbc0) |

Required object of optional members, processed in input order. The first checked failure stops later members and earlier writes remain. Ignored helper failures can still end in code 0. A true manual_exp or a calculated mosaic returns early with a result object and skips later members. In process type 1 a true wide_cam forwards the whole request to the peer; ISP-related members may also be forwarded according to view mode. A successful call with changed keys emits a Setting event whose payload is the filtered settings (not an echo of the request); some helpers emit it themselves. Client events are emitted by the guest-mode members. Per key: auto_power_off enables a 15-minute idle shutdown and skips a wrong type silently; guest_mode enabling makes the requester master, disabling requires master and closes the other connections, and resending the current value fails with a stale code; usb_en_eth switches Ethernet over USB-C through the gadget script; dark_mode sets the LED style and is forwarded to the secondary process. master_cli claims (true) or releases (false) master status. The iOS app is observed sending {lang} and {cli_uuid, cli_name} (2026-10-12). 32-bit and 64-bit members differ: wide_4k, main_8k, hdr, rtsp_roi_index and rtsp_roi_scale, stack_l_auto and others are D64 only or differ; the reduced 32-bit set is not enumerated here. Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 adds keys sky_replay (value ignored, feature force-disabled), annotation (object), preview.raw_bin2, enable_dark_library, can_encrypt (only true, a no-op), motion_monitor (validated object), exp_ms.more_exposure (tele camera only) and the stack members startrail_mode (wide camera only, 0 to 2, a change clears the stack) and startrails_duration_min (wide camera only, 259 while stacking), and drops expert_mode, which now gives 109 although get_setting still emits it; annotation or sky_replay sent together with wide_cam give 102. See the params schema.

Side effects: Writes shared operational settings and configuration, can change hardware (LED, heater, wheel), restart the preview stream, switch camera or guest mode, run scripts (USB gadget for usb_en_eth), close other client connections, arm the auto_power_off idle shutdown and relay to the peer. Not transactional; no rollback.

## Reply

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jsonrpc` | string | no | - | (error) Added by the socket layer (reply object constructor), not the handler fragment. Normally present; absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply. Receivers MUST NOT require it. Fixed value `"2.0"`. [READ; also OBSERVED on the wire (2026-10-12)] |
| `Timestamp` | string | no | - | (error) Decimal string `<seconds>.<nanoseconds>` with exactly nine fractional digits, formatted with `%ld.%09ld` from clock_gettime clock id 1. Linux clock id 1 is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, so the value is monotonic time, not wall-clock or Unix time (INFERRED from the clock id). On replies it is added by the socket layer and is normally present; receivers MUST NOT require it on replies (absent on a stop_func relay-failure reply). On events it is always written by the event constructor. [READ; wire shape also OBSERVED (2026-10-12)] |
| `method` | string | if the request had an id and a string method (handler errors and 103), except a locally built stop_func relay failure | - | (error) The request method, echoed. Absent on dispatcher errors 100 and 200 and on a stop_func relay failure. [READ] |
| `error` | string | yes | - | (error) Message looked up from the code; unknown codes yield "fail to operate". [READ] |
| `code` | integer | yes | - | (error) Nonzero. A requested code of 0 is coerced to 207. [READ] |
| `id` | any | yes | - | (error) The request id echoed with its JSON type; null on dispatcher errors 100 and 200, where it is the only way to recognise the reply and cannot be matched to a request. [READ] |

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 102 | Invalid temp_unit string, center_xy/offset not an array, ae_bri_percent not numeric, unknown preview enum (firmware 9.75, also image_transfer_mode above 1), malformed mosaic pair, typec_mode outside file/net; firmware 9.75, annotation or sky_replay sent in the same request as wide_cam | `invalid params` |
| 104 | Missing or noninteger coordinate; integer-only nested member wrong type (firmware 9.75 includes stack.startrail_mode, stack.startrails_duration_min and motion_monitor waiting_time and duration_min); stack save/goto booleans malformed; rtsp_roi_index, src_dura_min, light_brightness or rec_res_index wrong type | `expected int param` |
| 105 | String-only member given another type (preview, capt_type, password, typec_mode, cli_name, cli_uuid; firmware 9.75, motion_monitor mode) | `expected string param` |
| 106 | Strict boolean member given another type; firmware 9.75, can_encrypt, exp_ms.more_exposure and motion_monitor return_to_origin; firmware 9.75, sky_replay, preview.raw_bin2 or an annotation member given a type other than boolean or integer | `expected bool param` |
| 107 | Params missing or not an object; preview or timelapse not an object; firmware 9.75, motion_monitor not an object; firmware 9.75, annotation not an object | `expected object param` |
| 108 | Positional lon/lat non-numeric, delay_sec non-numeric, ROI scale non-numeric | `expected float param` |
| 109 | Unmatched top-level key (firmware 9.75 includes expert_mode), or a known name supplied with a type that bypasses its branch; firmware 9.75, unknown or null member name inside annotation | `unexpected param` |
| 200 | Guest helper cannot find the client socket, or master_cli from a local (internal) connection | `invalid id` |
| 203 | stack_lenhance while the wheel worker is running | `fail to operate` |
| 204 | Dither, ROI or ae_bri_percent out of limit | `out of limit` |
| 207 | Explicit beep/heater failure, LED helper failure, Alpaca busy or timeout, Type-C script error, any failure with no internal code | `fail to operate` |
| 209 | Capture type incompatible with the camera; unknown selected_cam; firmware 9.75, stack.startrail_mode above 2 or negative, motion_monitor mode or sensitivity out of range, threshold mismatch, negative waiting_time or an invalid duration_min (the duration case INFERRED) | `invalid value` |
| 210 | Unsupported lang, timelapse view, stack_l_auto on non-wide camera, capability or NFC missing, Alpaca in slave, master_cli outside guest mode; firmware 9.75, can_encrypt false, stack.startrail_mode or stack.startrails_duration_min on a non-wide camera, exp_ms.more_exposure on the wide camera | `not supported` |
| 259 | Stack active while changing stack_l_auto, stack_l or capture type; enabling user_stack_sim while stacking; firmware 9.75, stack.startrails_duration_min while stacking (startrail_mode has no such check, it clears the stack instead) | `stack is already running` |
| 267 | user_stack_sim enabled when the simulation image check fails | `no image` |
| 300 | wide_cross_offset on a non-wide camera locally; master_cli by a non-master while a master exists | `internal error` |
| 318 | Wheel unavailable for stack_lenhance, or camera absent or closed for mosaic | `device not connected` |
| 524 | Preview quality during video recording; changed rec_res_index during RTSP plus recording; firmware 9.75, a changed motion_monitor while the motion-monitor function runs | `function conflict` |
| 536 | Capture-type change or user_stack_sim during a view plan; selected_cam during a non-dual view plan | `view plan is already running` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Messages follow the shared label table. Many downstream codes are dynamic and not a closed set. Resending the current guest_mode value fails with the thread's last error code, which is stale. An error reply carries no result and earlier changes remain. Each code listed also has 200 invalid id at dispatch when the id is missing.

## Example

Request, request - Two settings:

```json
{"id":171,"method":"set_setting","params":{"temp_unit":"C","lang":"en"}}
```

Request, manual - Switch to manual exposure:

```json
{"id":172,"method":"set_setting","params":{"manual_exp":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":171}
```

Reply, manual-ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_setting","result":{"isp_exp_ms":100.0,"isp_gain":80.0},"code":0,"id":172}
```

Reply, unknown-key:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_setting","error":"unexpected param","code":109,"id":173}
```
